conventions.population: pool E only (AgentDrift benign, hard_negative, attacked); unsuccessful attacks excluded
conventions.bootstrap: trajectory-level stratified bootstrap (n_pos, n_neg fixed), B=2000, one RNG seed per population (crc32 of its name, stored in domain_shift_work/boot/<name>.json); all detectors of a population share the resampled rows (paired); different populations are independent
conventions.multi_seed: GRU, GRU-drop0.2, GRU-drop0.1 have 3 training seeds: each bootstrap replicate uses one seed drawn at random (evalkit.bootstrap convention), so intervals include seed variation; the point estimate is the mean over seeds (evalkit.point). 'GRU#seedk' rows use seed k only
conventions.AUPRC_p10: prevalence-weighted average precision at pi=0.10, positive weight pi/(1-pi)*n_neg/n_pos (plan 3.1)
conventions.AUPRC_native: unweighted average precision at the population's own prevalence
conventions.precision_pXX@op: precision implied at prevalence XX% by recall and FPR at the operating point
conventions.interval: 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles of the bootstrap distribution; point = full-sample estimate
conventions.p_holm: Holm step-down over the stated family of five (folds, domains or seeds); detected_holm = p_holm < 0.05

families.M3.R1_domain_paired.<pair>.<metric>: five domains (R1 domain-matched), per pair and metric
families.M3.R3_paired.<pair>.<metric>: five R3 folds, per pair and metric (plan 3.6 a, b)
families.M3.R3_minus_R1dm.<det>.<metric>: five folds, per detector and metric (plan 3.6 c)
families.M4.deltas.<det@op>.<comparator>.<recall|: five folds, per detector, threshold, comparator and metric
families.m5 domain-matched: five domains per detector and split seed; pooled: five split seeds per detector

conventions.reversal_rule: plan 3.4: established in a fold iff the R1 domain-matched paired advantage is detected (Holm over five domains, positive) AND the R3 paired difference is detected with the opposite sign (Holm over five folds). Primary metric AUROC (the manuscript's reversal claim); AUPRC_p10 reported as secondary

survives_remedy.definition: reversal established for LR-C-minus-LR-B in the fold AND R3 LR-C-drop-minus-LR-B detected negative after Holm
reversal established for LR-C-minus-LR-B in the fold AND R3 LR-C-drop-minus-LR-B detected negative after Holm
reversal established for GRU-minus-LR-C in the fold AND R3 GRU-drop0.2-minus-LR-C detected negative after Holm
reversal established for GRU-minus-LR-C in the fold AND R3 GRU-drop0.2-minus-LR-C detected negative after Holm

M3_world_cluster_sensitivity.definition: world-cluster bootstrap (clusters = world keys within each population, resampled with replacement, B = 2000), sensitivity analysis for plan 3.5; the primary M3 analysis uses the trajectory-level stratified bootstrap

M4.legend: cell lists each detected change of R3 relative to the comparator at the stated threshold: FPR+ / FPR- = false-positive rate up / down, rec+ / rec- = recall up / down; 'holds' = no detected change (plan 3.3 threshold failure = any detected change)

m12.definition: classifier two-sample test: StandardScaler + LogisticRegression(max_iter=5000, class_weight='balanced') on representation B (10 behavioural features) predicting test membership; StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=0); AUROC of the pooled out-of-fold scores with a stratified bootstrap interval (B=2000) over those scores. 0.5 = train and test indistinguishable in representation B

reference_mix.definition: all 4,706 AgentDrift attacked trajectories (union of the five R3 held-out pools)

m5_overlap_sensitivity.definition: overlap-preserving bootstrap: the union of the R1 and R1-wd pool-E test sets (of the domain, for the domain-matched version) is resampled with replacement, stratified by class; each pool is evaluated on the resampled rows that belong to it, scored by its own model; B = 2,000; one training seed per replicate and pool for the GRU; point estimates as in m5

m12_extra.definition: same C2ST as m12 (representation B, StandardScaler + LR(class_weight='balanced'), StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle)). 'full' entries add the m12 bootstrap interval; 'fold_seed_spread' repeats the pooled out-of-fold AUROC for fold-assignment seeds 0-4 (seed 0 = the m12 value); cross-validated AgentDojo settings: one C2ST per (repetition, fold) train/test pair of the shared cache (training rows exactly as the cache's fits: P0 rows of the other folds, plus the failed attacks of the other folds for WUT_F), fold-assignment seed 0 for the C2ST itself

mc_stability_B10000.definition: families with any member p or p_holm in [0.03, 0.07] at B = 2,000 are recomputed at B = 10000 with fresh RNG streams (crc32(population + '|B10000')); Holm is redone over the whole family; point estimates are unchanged

LR-B.note: transfer AUROC on AgentDojo P0 from the linear cache (point only)

LR-C.note: transfer AUROC on AgentDojo P0 from the linear cache (point only)

references_v03.source: archive_v0.3/r1r3_corrected.json cross_rung_LOGREG_independent.R2_newtask-minus-R1.native.AUROC (v0.3 manuscript Sec. VI-C: +0.023 [+0.001, +0.046]); delta = bootstrap mean
